evidence.quote: Schedule of Investments, table 23 row 19: Total Investments - 235.7% | $ | 3,403,111 | $ | 3,228,940
Balance sheet, table 4 row 6: Total investments, at fair value (cost of $3,403,111) | $ | 3,228,940
Balance sheet, table 4 row 4: Non-controlled/non-affiliated investments | $ | 3,159,468; row 5: Non-controlled affiliated investments | 69,472; these sum to 3,228,940 (all amounts in thousands)

rationale: The filing presents a single final Total Investments row at fair value of $3,228,940 thousand. The balance sheet independently reports the same amount, composed of $3,159,468 thousand non-controlled/non-affiliated investments plus $69,472 thousand non-controlled affiliated investments. Thus the companyfacts tag is complete and already includes the affiliated investment schedule. The separately reported $2,476 thousand affiliated money market fund is cash-equivalent collateral outside the balance-sheet line Total investments, at fair value, and is not part of this anchor. The total equals 96.59% of total assets of $3,342,857 thousand, leaving a plausible non-investment remainder.
